segments.text:
CIrcumciſion is aboliſhed, 1. Becauſe the thing ſignified is exhibited. For among other things it ſignified, that the Meſſias promiſed vnto the Fathers ſhould come at length in his appointed time, and ſhould in our behalfe take our nature. 2. Becauſe circumciſion was inſtituted for the ſeuering of the Iewes from all other Nations: but now the church, that difference being aboliſhed, is collected and gathered out of al Nations. And now the ſacrament of baptiſme performerth the ſame vnto vs, which circumciſion did vnto them. Moreouer, as circumciſion was a ſigne vnto them of their receiuing into
the people of God. So is baptiſme vnto vs the firſt mark which ſeuereth the church from the wicked.
